payout_quote: Cullman Clinical Trials, Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy Study — Now Enrolling: "We are conducting a 3-month study to evaluate the effectiveness of a medication in reducing neuropathy pain in the feet. Eligible participants may receive either the active medication or a placebo and can earn up to $2,000 in compensation."
steps: Open the Cullman Clinical Trials diabetic peripheral neuropathy study page and fill out the intake form (name, email, phone, current medical conditions).
A team member will contact you to discuss eligibility and schedule screening.
Pass the medical screening for the study (participants must not be taking opioids, gabapentin, or Lyrica; not everyone qualifies).
Participate in the 3-month study (eligible participants may receive the active medication or a placebo); all medical care related to the study is provided at no cost.
Receive compensation up to $2,000 for completing the study.
catches: You must have diabetic peripheral neuropathy (foot pain) and must not be taking opioids, gabapentin, or Lyrica; you must pass screening — not everyone qualifies.
The $2,000 is an "up to" ceiling for completing the 3-month study; no floor is stated.
You may receive either the active medication or a placebo — an investigational treatment with real medical risks and side effects.
A 3-month study requires a real time commitment: screening plus repeated on-site visits in Cullman, Alabama.
Clinical trial compensation is generally taxable income; earn $600+/year and you may receive a 1099.
Freshness caveat: the study page was indexed ~157 days before verification; confirm the study is still enrolling before applying.
The official listing does not state the exact visit schedule or visit count, so the total time above is an estimate — the actual time commitment could be higher.
biggest_catch: The $2,000 is an "up to" ceiling for completing a 3-month neuropathy study in Cullman, AL — you must have diabetic peripheral neuropathy, pass strict medication exclusions (not everyone qualifies), and may receive a placebo or investigational medication with real medical risks.
eligibility: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy (neuropathy pain in the feet); must not be taking opioids, gabapentin, or Lyrica; must pass screening; able to attend visits in Cullman, AL.
timing: Compensation is paid for participating in/completing the 3-month study; all study-related medical care is provided at no cost.
